acceptanceCriteria: Root cause identified or the hypothesis refuted with evidence.
The test passes 50x under -race with CPU burners, and a mutant that reintroduces the race fails.
body: Suspected flake, observed 2026-10-19 on batch PR #1209 head 15387a190: internal/tasks/cli TestCALV0052_DispatchCLIClaimHandoffAndStatus failed once at load average ~25 with 'dispatch status touched the native store'; it then passed 13x alone and on a full shard rerun. Hypothesis (unconfirmed): a worker from the first dispatch tick may still write to the state directory while the status snapshot is taken. Expected: status read is isolated from in-flight worker writes, or the test waits for workers to quiesce.
title: TestCALV0052_DispatchCLIClaimHandoffAndStatus flakes under load: 'dispatch status touched the native store'
